description.narrative: The Project will grow Editas production capacity and operations in Iraq. IFC anticipates that this will contribute to Iraqs economy by generating jobs, increasing processing capacity, adding value to domestically sourced cereals, creating inter-sector linkages, and generating revenue to the Government of Iraq through VAT, corporate income taxes, etc. In addition, the Project is expected to localize a well-known foreign brand in Iraq, through a South-South regional integration to build up additional local production capacity, ultimately introducing new product lines to diversify its current offering in the market beyond cakes and bakeries. This should enhance operational capacity and improve competitiveness in the market among mid-income consumers as well as within the premium snacks segment.

The proposed investment consists of an up to US$25 million (M) A-Loan under Expedited Processing for Existing Clients to IFCs client Edita Food Industries S.A.E (Edita or the Parent Company), and its subsidiaries Ahramat Al-Nile for General Trading and Food Industries Ltd. (formerly TJA) (the Company or Edita Iraq), Edita Participation Cyprus Ltd. (Edita Cyprus) and Edita for Trade and Distribution S.A.E (together the Co-Borrowers). The loan will be used to support (i) new operations in Iraq by financing the expansion of production lines, equipment, property, and working capital, aiming to more than double capacity and fully commission new lines by 2028 and (ii) Editas operations in Egypt with working capital.
